planets.name: WASP-105 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-105 with a 7.87-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: WASP-105 b was found in 2017 by SuperWASP-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-105. Its orbit and size follow Anderson et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
